newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's natural gas output up 10.5 pct Jan-July.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's natural gas output up 10.5 pct Jan-July.

text.p: Mexican state oil firm Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said on Friday it processed 3.410 billion cubic feet per day of natural gas in the first seven months, up 10.5 percent from the same period last year.
Pemex Gas and Basic Petrochemicals produced an average 474,000 barrels per day of ethane, liquid gas and gasolines, up 5.3 percent from January-July 1995.
Broken down, the output was 215,000 bpd of liquid gas, 172,000 bpd of ethane and 87,000 bpd of gasolines during the seven-month period.
